## Rust — dpp

> v4.1.1 → v5.0.0 spans the whole 4.2.0-dev/beta and 5.0.0-beta/rc trains (~216 PRs touching `packages/rs-dpp/src`). Nearly every consensus change is gated on **protocol version 14** (PV14): v13 behaviour replays byte-for-byte, so most grammar/validation rows below only bite once the network activates PV14. Rust API breaks (enum variants, struct fields, renamed traits, signature changes) bite at compile time regardless. Rows are grouped: serialization & decoding → document ids & batch → new state transitions → identity keys → contract groups → moderation → action fees → tokens → shielded → document-type schema grammar → validation tightening → withdrawals/contests → consensus error families.
